title.narrative: Countering Backlash - Reclaiming Women’s Rights in Jordan

description.narrative:
The project aims to support two Jordanian women's rights organizations, namely the Arab Women Organization and Takatoat. The project will work to strengthen women's participation , strengthen respect for women's rights, ensure protection from violence, and will include capacity building activities by Kvinna till Kvinna to counter the Anti-Gender Movement that is also impacting Jordan.
The project will strengthen women in Jordan through a holistic approach that includes GBV support, awareness raising, and connection to the feminist/women’s-movement in the region. By linking an older organization with grassroots activists- and organizations, the project will contribute to a more robust and better-interlinked women's movement. Through offering GBV support, the project aims to empower survivors, protect their rights, and work towards preventing future occurrences of GBV. Through raising awareness about women's rights, the project will increase understanding and consciousness among individuals, communities, and society at large about issues related to gender equality, women's rights, and GBV. Awareness-raising efforts may include educational campaigns, workshops, seminars, and community events to challenge harmful gender norms, stereotypes, and attitudes while promoting respect, equality, and empowerment.
The project will create safe spaces where Women Rights Actors (WRAs) can support each other in developing common visions, strategic thinking, and coordination. This in turn will create spaces for-dialogue and listening with the grassroots organizations/movements to increase knowledge sharing and capacity building.
